new_libraries.name: dw-link
new_libraries.author: Bernhard Nebel
new_libraries.sentence: Turns your Arduino Uno into a hardware debugger for debugWIRE MCUs
new_libraries.paragraph:
After loading the example sketch dw-link onto your Arduino UNO, you can
use the UNO together with PyAvrOCD to debug programs
on any debugWIRE MCU. You only have to install
one of the alternative cores MicroCore, TinyCore, or MiniCore by MCUdude.
